comments.value: Related by: See avatar AUTHOR of avatar you are wearing https://vrchat.canny.io/feature-requests/p/see-avatar-author-of-avatar-you-are-wearing

VRChat provided Virtual Market 3 with the feature sending URL to Web browser.
https://twitter.com/Virtual_Market_/status/1174597576030470144
So that is possible and the button on Social menu opening user Web page should be implemented.
This has been resolved in VRChat 2021.4.1.

details:
An user ID (starts with “usr_”) should be displayed in the menu for preventing spoofing. It is more prefer that a button copying it be also provided. The present menu display a Display Name only.
